title: Capacity Allocation at the Source: Sparse Target Optimization for LLM Knowledge Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.12995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge editing has emerged as a promising approach for efficiently updating embedded knowledge in large language models (LLMs). It first computes an ideal target hidden state that steers the LLM toward the new output, and then edits the model parameters so that the original hidden state is mapped to this target. While most existing methods focus on the second stage of parameter editing in preserving other knowledge, we find that the upstream construction of the target hidden state also plays an important role in allocating the model's limited capacity space. We first establish a theoretical connection between interference in the parameter space and interference between target hidden states, showing that the two are positively correlated. Building on this insight, we propose a simple yet effective $\ell_1$ regularization method that prunes away unnecessary ``tentacles'' of each knowledge vector, retaining only the essential components.

translated_title: 源头上的容量分配：面向大语言模型知识编辑的稀疏目标优化
translated_abstract: 知识编辑已成为一种高效更新大语言模型（LLM）中嵌入知识的有前景的方法。它首先计算一个引导LLM产生新输出的理想目标隐状态，然后编辑模型参数，使原始隐状态映射到该目标。虽然现有大多数方法关注第二阶段的参数编辑以保护其他知识，我们发现目标隐状态的上游构建在分配模型有限的容量空间方面也起着重要作用。我们首先建立了参数空间中的干扰与目标隐状态之间的干扰之间的理论联系，表明两者呈正相关。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种简单而有效的 $\ell_1$ 正则化方法，该方法修剪掉每个知识向量不必要的“触角”，仅保留必要的组成部分。
tldr: 该论文建立了参数空间干扰与目标隐状态干扰之间的正相关理论联系，并提出一种 $\ell_1$ 正则化方法对知识向量进行稀疏化，从源头优化目标隐状态构建以更好地分配模型有限容量空间。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a positive theoretical correlation between interference in parameter space and interference between target hidden states, and proposes a simple yet effective $\ell_1$ regularization method to sparsify knowledge vectors, optimizing target construction at the source for better model capacity allocation in LLM knowledge editing.
